64void change_fullscreen_option(FullscreenOptions option)
65{
66
67 SDL_DisplayMode DM;
68 if (SDL_GetDesktopDisplayMode(0, &DM) == 0)
69 {
70 switch(option)
71 {
72 case FSOPT_FULLSCREEN:
73 SCREEN_WIDTH = DM.w;
74 SCREEN_HEIGHT = DM.h;
75 SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(window, SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN);
76 break;
77 case FSOPT_BORDERLESS:
78 SCREEN_WIDTH = DM.w;
79 SCREEN_HEIGHT = DM.h;
80 SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(window, SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN_DESKTOP);
81 break;
82 case FSOPT_WINDOWED:
83 SDL_SetWindowFullscreen(window, 0);
84 SDL_GetWindowSize(window, &SCREEN_WIDTH, &SCREEN_HEIGHT);
85 break;
86 default:
87 break;
88 }
89 }
90 EDITOR_SETTINGS.current_fullscreen_option = option;
91
92}

169{

181void clear_undo(Undo * undo)
182{
183 undo->next = NULL;
184 undo->free = true;
185 if (undo->special_count > 0)
186 {
187 for (int i = 0; i < undo->special_count; i++)
188 {
189 if (undo->special_bytes) free(undo->special_bytes[i]);
190 undo->special_bytes[i] = NULL;
191 }
192 if (undo->special_bytes) free(undo->special_bytes);
193 undo->special_bytes = NULL;
194 }
195 undo->byte_offset = 0;
196 undo->byte_size = 0;
197 undo->special_count = 0;
198
199}

201void destroy_undo(Undo * undo)
202{
203 if (undo->next)
204 {
205 undo->next->prev = NULL;
206 }
207
208 Undo * current = undo;
209 while(current->prev)
210 {
211 clear_undo(current->prev);
212 Undo * tmp = current;
213 current = current->prev;
214 tmp->prev = NULL;
215 }
216
217 clear_undo(undo);
218
219}

251void link_undo(Undo * undo)
252{
253
254 if (undo->prev)
255 {
256 undo->prev->next = NULL;
257 }
258 undo->prev = top_undo;
259 if (top_undo) top_undo->next = undo;
260 if (undo->next)
261 {
262 undo->next->prev = NULL;
263 }
264 undo->next = NULL;
265 undo->free = false;
266 top_undo = undo;
267 next_redo = NULL;
268
269}

272void check_stack_size()
273{
274 while (undo_stack_size > EDITOR_SETTINGS.undo_stack_max_byte_size && top_undo)
275 {
276 Undo * current = top_undo;
277 if (!current) return;
278 while(current->prev)
279 {
280 current = current->prev;
281 }
282 destroy_undo(current);
283 if (top_undo == current) top_undo = NULL;
284 }
285}

303void perform_newest_redo()
304{
305 if (!next_redo) return;

307 Undo * undo = next_redo;

315void destroy_redo_history()
316{
317
318 if (!top_undo) return;
319 Undo * current = top_undo;
320 Undo * next = current->next;
321 while(next)
322 {
323
324 current = next;
325 current->free = true;
326 current->prev = NULL;
327 next = current->next;
328 clear_undo(current);
329
330 }

463void execute_light_undo(Undo * undo)
464{
465 Light * lights = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.lights, Light);
466 Light * light = &lights[undo->structure.ids[0]];
467 switch(undo->structure.special)
468 {
469 case UNDOSPECIAL_NONE:
470 execute_non_special_undo(undo, (uint8_t*)light);
471 break;
472 case UNDOLIGHT_SPAWN:
473
474 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*));
475 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(Light));
476 memcpy(bytes[0], light, sizeof(Light));
477 size_t total_bytes = sizeof(uint8_t*) + sizeof(Light);
478 undo->byte_size = total_bytes;
479 undo->special_bytes = bytes;
480 undo->special_count = 1;
481 destroy_entity(&ENTITIES[lights[GLOBALS.lights.count-1].entity_id]);
482 int temp = EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_light_id;
483 EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_light_id = undo->structure.ids[1];
484 undo->structure.ids[1] = temp;
485
486 REMOVE_FROM_VEC(&GLOBALS.lights, undo->structure.ids[0], Light);
487
488 undo->structure.special = UNDOLIGHT_DELETE;
489
490 break;
491
492 case UNDOLIGHT_DELETE:
493
494 for (int i = GLOBALS.lights.count; i > undo->structure.ids[0]; i--)
495 {
496 lights[i] = lights[i-1];
497 }
498 GLOBALS.lights.count++;
499 memcpy(&lights[undo->structure.ids[0]], undo->special_bytes[0], sizeof(Light));
500 undo->structure.ids[1] = EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_light_id;
501 EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_light_id = undo->structure.ids[0];
502 free(undo->special_bytes[0]);
503 free(undo->special_bytes);
504 undo->special_bytes = NULL;
505 undo->special_count = 0;
506 undo->byte_size = 0;
507 undo->structure.special = UNDOLIGHT_SPAWN;
508 break;
509 default:
510 break;
511 }
512 light->sm_dirty = true;
513 GLOBALS.lights_dirty = true;
514}

563void execute_editor_settings_undo(Undo * undo)
564{
565
566 int temp[8];
567 switch(undo->structure.special)
568 {
569 case UNDOSPECIAL_NONE:
570 execute_non_special_undo(undo, (uint8_t*)&EDITOR_SETTINGS);
571 break;
572 case UNDOEDITORSETTINGS_FULLSCREENOPT:
573 temp[0] = EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_fullscreen_option;
574 EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_fullscreen_option = undo->structure.ids[0];

577 break;
578 case UNDOEDITORSETTINGS_SCREEN_RES:
579 temp[0] = SCREEN_WIDTH;

581 SCREEN_WIDTH = undo->structure.ids[0];

585 break;
586 case UNDOEDITORSETTINGS_RENDER_RES:
587 temp[0] = RENDER_WIDTH;

594 case UNDOEDITORSETTINGS_SSAO_RES:
595 temp[0] = SSAO_WIDTH;
596 temp[1] = SSAO_HEIGHT;
597 change_ssao_res(undo->structure.ids[0], undo->structure.ids[1]);
598 memcpy(undo->structure.ids, temp, sizeof(int) * 8);

600 case UNDOEDITORSETTINGS_DOF_RES:

604 memcpy(undo->structure.ids, temp, sizeof(int) * 8);
605 break;
606 case UNDOEDITORSETTINGS_BLOOM_RES:
607 temp[0] = BLOOM_WIDTH;
608 temp[1] = BLOOM_HEIGHT;
609 change_bloom_res(undo->structure.ids[0], undo->structure.ids[1]);
610 memcpy(undo->structure.ids, temp, sizeof(int) * 8);
611 break;
612 case UNDOEDITORSETTINGS_HALFSIZE_EFFECTS:
613 temp[0] = SSAO_WIDTH;
614 temp[1] = SSAO_HEIGHT;
615 temp[2] = DOF_WIDTH;
616 temp[3] = DOF_HEIGHT;
617 temp[4] = BLOOM_WIDTH;
618 temp[5] = BLOOM_HEIGHT;
619 change_ssao_res(undo->structure.ids[0], undo->structure.ids[1]);
620 change_dof_res(undo->structure.ids[2], undo->structure.ids[3]);
621 change_bloom_res(undo->structure.ids[4], undo->structure.ids[5]);
622 memcpy(undo->structure.ids, temp, sizeof(int) * 8);
623 break;
624 default:
625 break;
626 }
627
628}

641void execute_rprobe_undo(Undo * undo)
642{
643
644 ReflectionProbe * rprobes = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.scene_data.reflection_probes, ReflectionProbe);
645 ReflectionProbe * rp = &rprobes[undo->structure.ids[0]];
646 int temp[8];
647 switch(undo->structure.special)
648 {
649 case UNDOSPECIAL_NONE:
650 execute_non_special_undo(undo, (uint8_t*)rp);
651 break;
652 case UNDORPROBE_SPAWN:
653 {
654
655 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*));
656 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(ReflectionProbe));
657 memcpy(bytes[0], rp, sizeof(ReflectionProbe));
658
659 temp[0] = undo->structure.ids[0];
660 temp[1] = EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_r_probe;
661
662 REMOVE_FROM_VEC(&GLOBALS.scene_data.reflection_probes, undo->structure.ids[0], ReflectionProbe);
663 EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_r_probe = undo->structure.ids[1];
664
665 memcpy(undo->structure.ids, temp, sizeof(int) * 8);
666 undo->special_bytes = bytes;
667 undo->byte_size = sizeof(uint8_t*) + sizeof(ReflectionProbe);
668 undo->special_count = 1;
669
670 undo->structure.special = UNDORPROBE_DELETE;
671
672 }
673 break;
674
675 case UNDORPROBE_DELETE:
676 {
677
678 SHIFT_VEC_RIGHT(&GLOBALS.scene_data.reflection_probes, undo->structure.ids[0], ReflectionProbe);
679 memcpy(rp, undo->special_bytes[0], sizeof(ReflectionProbe));
680 temp[0] = undo->structure.ids[0];
681 temp[1] = EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_r_probe;
682 EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_r_probe = undo->structure.ids[1];
683
684 clear_special_undo_bytes(undo);
685 memcpy(undo->structure.ids, temp, sizeof(int) * 8);
686
687 undo->structure.special = UNDORPROBE_SPAWN;
688 }
689
690 break;
691 default:
692 break;
693 }
694}

696void execute_lprobe_undo(Undo * undo)
697{
698 ProbeVolume * pvs = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.scene_data.lighting_probe_volumes, ProbeVolume);
699 ProbeVolume * pv = &pvs[undo->structure.ids[0]];
700 int temp[8];
701 switch(undo->structure.special)
702 {
703 case UNDOSPECIAL_NONE:
704
705 execute_non_special_undo(undo, (uint8_t*)pv);
706 break;
707
708 case UNDOLPROBE_SPAWN:
709 {
710
711 // set up bytes to receive the current probe volume
712 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*));
713 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(ProbeVolume));
714 memcpy(bytes[0], pv, sizeof(ProbeVolume));
715 // delete the probe volume to undo the spawn
716 REMOVE_FROM_VEC(&GLOBALS.scene_data.lighting_probe_volumes, undo->structure.ids[0], ProbeVolume);
717 // flip the ids that will be used for the redo
718 temp[0] = undo->structure.ids[0];
719 temp[1] = EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id;
720 EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id = undo->structure.ids[1];
721 memcpy(undo->structure.ids, temp, sizeof(int) * 8);
722 // reset special fields to reflect how we set up the redo
723 undo->special_bytes = bytes;
724 undo->special_count = 1;
725 undo->byte_size = sizeof(uint8_t*) + sizeof(ProbeVolume);
726 // on redo we will "undo the delete"
727 undo->structure.special = UNDOLPROBE_DELETE;
728
729 }
730 break;
731
732 case UNDOLPROBE_RESET_LPVS:
733
734 for (int i = 0; i < LPV_SLOTS; i++)
735 {
736 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[i].pv_id = undo->structure.ids[i];
737 if (GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[i].lprobes) free(GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[i].lprobes);
738 if (undo->special_bytes[i])
739 {
740 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[i].lprobes = malloc(sizeof(float) * LPV_PADDED_COUNT * 3 * SH_MAX);
741 memcpy(GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[i].lprobes, undo->special_bytes[i], sizeof(float) * LPV_PADDED_COUNT * 3 * SH_MAX);
742 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV_FLAG[i] = true;
743 }

1369 byte_count = 1;
1370 memcpy(bytes[0], tb->text, sizeof(char) * tb->text_cap);
1371
1372 free(tb->text);
1373 tb->text_cap = 0;
1374 tb->text = NULL;
1375 }
1376 if (undo->special_count > 0)
1377 {
1378 tb->text_cap = undo->structure.ids[2];
1379 tb->text = malloc(sizeof(char) * tb->text_cap);
1380 memcpy(tb->text, undo->special_bytes[0], sizeof(char) * tb->text_cap);
1381 }
1382
1383 clear_special_undo_bytes(undo);
1384 undo->special_bytes = bytes;
1385 undo->special_count = byte_count;
1386 undo->byte_size = byte_size;
1387 undo->structure.ids[2] = text_cap;
1388
1389 add_all_text_boxes_to_draw_buffer();
1390 }
1391
1392 break;
1393 case UNDOTEXTBOX_CHANGE_CONTAINER:
1394 if (undo->structure.ids[2] != -1)
1395 {
1396 remove_text_box_from_container(&cs[undo->structure.ids[2]], tb);
1397 }
1398 if (undo->structure.ids[3] != -1)
1399 {
1400 assign_text_box_to_container(tb, &cs[undo->structure.ids[3]]);
1401 }
1402 tb->parent_container = undo->structure.ids[3];
1403 int s0 = undo->structure.ids[2];
1404 int s1 = undo->structure.ids[3];
1405 undo->structure.ids[2] = s1;
1406 undo->structure.ids[3] = s0;
1407
1408 break;
1409
1410 case UNDOTEXTBOX_REMOVE_FROM_CONTAINER:
1411 assign_text_box_to_container(tb, &cs[undo->structure.ids[2]]);
1412 break;
1413 case UNDOTEXTBOX_ADD_TO_CONTAINER:
1414 remove_text_box_from_container(&cs[undo->structure.ids[2]], tb);
1415 break;
1416
1417 default:
1418 break;
1419
1420
1421 }
1422
1423
1424}

1426void execute_asset_instance_undo(Undo * undo)
1427{
1428
1429 AssetInstance * AI = &ASSET_INSTANCES[undo->structure.ids[0]];
1430 int temp[8];
1431 switch(undo->structure.special)
1432 {
1433 case UNDOSPECIAL_NONE:
1434 execute_non_special_undo(undo, (uint8_t*)AI);
1435 break;
1436 case UNDOASSETINSTANCE_ROTATION_ANGLE:
1437 {
1438
1439 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*) * 3);
1440 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(float));
1441 bytes[1] = malloc(sizeof(mat4));
1442 bytes[2] = malloc(sizeof(vec3));
1443 memcpy(bytes[0], &EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_angle, sizeof(float));
1444 memcpy(bytes[1], &AI->model, sizeof(mat4));
1445 memcpy(bytes[2], &AI->rot, sizeof(vec3));
1446
1447 memcpy(&EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_angle, undo->special_bytes[0], sizeof(float));
1448 memcpy(&AI->model, undo->special_bytes[1], sizeof(mat4));
1449 memcpy(&AI->rot, undo->special_bytes[2], sizeof(vec3));
1450
1451 free(undo->special_bytes[0]);
1452 free(undo->special_bytes[1]);
1453 free(undo->special_bytes[2]);
1454 free(undo->special_bytes);
1455 undo->special_bytes = bytes;
1456 AI->model = compose_trs_from_vectors(AI->tr, AI->rot, AI->scale);
1457
1458 }
1459 break;
1460 case UNDOASSETINSTANCE_MAT:
1461 execute_non_special_undo(undo, (uint8_t*)AI);
1462 AI->model = compose_trs_from_vectors(AI->tr, AI->rot, AI->scale);
1463 break;
1464 default:
1465 break;
1466 }
1467
1468}

1470void execute_mesh_node_undo(Undo * undo)

1505 case UNDOMN_MAT:

1517 undo->structure.ids[2] = temp;

1519
1520 draw_dirty = true;
1521 }
1522
1523 break;
1524 default:
1525 break;
1526 }

1635void update_performance_overlay(GLuint64 query_s[PQUERY_MAX])
1636{
1637
1638 UIMenu * ms = CAST_VEC(MENUS, UIMenu);
1639 UIMenu * m = &ms[PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_MENU];
1640 TextBox * boxes = m->text_boxes;
1641 int query = 0;
1642 TextBox * box = &boxes[PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_TEXT_BOX_START];
1643
1644 sprintf(box->text, "Performance Overlay");
1645
1646 move_text_box_to_origin(box);
1647
1648 double full_time = 0.0f;
1649 for (int i = PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_TEXT_BOX_START+1; i < PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_TEXT_BOX_START + (PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_TEXT_BOX_COUNT - 1); i++)
1650 {
1651
1652 TextBox * box = &boxes[i];
1653
1654 double time = query_s[query] / 1e6;
1655 full_time += time;
1656 sprintf(box->text, "%s: %.3f", QUERY_NAMES[query], time);
1657 move_text_box_to_origin(box);
1658
1659
1660 query++;
1661 }
1662 TextBox * end = &boxes[PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_TEXT_BOX_START + PERFORMANCE_OVERLAY_TEXT_BOX_COUNT-1];
1663
1664 sprintf(end->text, "Frame Time: %.3f (%.3f FPS)", full_time, 1000.0f/full_time);
1665 move_text_box_to_origin(end);
1666
1667
1668
1669 add_all_text_boxes_to_draw_buffer();
1670
1671}

1711// a is src, b is the potentially modified value
1712bool nk_check_equivalency(void * a, void * b, size_t byte_size, NKSlider * s, bool * dirty)
1713{
1714 bool push_undo = false;
1715 // if a != b, we are sliding
1716 if (memcmp(a, b, byte_size) != 0)
1717 {
1718 // if we were not yet sliding, store the value
1719 if (!s->is_held)
1720 {
1721 s->byte_size = byte_size;
1722 memcpy(s->bytes, a, byte_size);
1723 }
1724 // now we are sliding
1725 s->is_held = true;
1726 // if we need to store dirty state
1727 if (dirty != NULL)
1728 {
1729 *dirty = true;
1730 }
1731 // change a to b
1732 memcpy(a, b, byte_size);
1733 // if we have a new action, the redo history is reset
1734 destroy_redo_history();
1735 }
1736 else
1737 {
1738 // if we were held and now we have stopped, signal to push the undo
1739 if (s->is_held)
1740 {
1741 push_undo = true;
1742 }
1743 s->is_held = false;
1744 }
1745 return push_undo;
1746}
1747
1748bool check_equivalencyv3(vec3 * a, vec3 b, NKSlider * s, bool * dirty)
1749{
1750
1751 bool push_undo = false;
1752 if (!vec3_equal(*a, b, 1e-6))
1753 {
1754 if (!s->is_held)
1755 {
1756 s->byte_size = sizeof(vec3);
1757 memcpy(s->bytes, a, sizeof(vec3));
1758 }
1759 s->is_held = true;
1760 if (dirty != NULL)
1761 {
1762 *dirty = true;
1763 }
1764 *a = b;
1765 destroy_redo_history();
1766 }
1767 else
1768 {
1769 if (s->is_held)
1770 {
1771 // push onto undo stack
1772 push_undo = true;
1773 }
1774 s->is_held = false;
1775 }
1776 return push_undo;
1777}
1778bool check_equivalencyv4(vec4 * a, vec4 b, NKSlider * s, bool * dirty)
1779{
1780
1781 bool push_undo = false;
1782 if (!vec4_equal(*a, b, 1e-6))
1783 {
1784 if (!s->is_held)
1785 {
1786 s->byte_size = sizeof(vec4);
1787 memcpy(s->bytes, a, sizeof(vec4));
1788 push_undo = true;
1789 }
1790 s->is_held = true;
1791 if (dirty != NULL)
1792 {
1793 *dirty = true;
1794 }
1795 *a = b;
1796 destroy_redo_history();
1797 }
1798 else
1799 {
1800 s->is_held = false;
1801 }
1802 return push_undo;
1803}
1804
1805bool check_equivalencyf(float * a, float b, NKSlider * s, bool * dirty)
1806{
1807 bool push_undo = false;
1808 if (*a != b)
1809 {
1810 if (!s->is_held)
1811 {
1812 s->byte_size = sizeof(float);
1813 memcpy(s->bytes, a, sizeof(float));
1814 push_undo = true;
1815 }
1816 s->is_held = true;
1817 if (dirty != NULL)
1818 {
1819 *dirty = true;
1820 }
1821 *a = b;
1822 destroy_redo_history();
1823 }
1824 else
1825 {
1826 s->is_held = false;
1827 }
1828 return push_undo;
1829}
1830bool check_equivalencyi(int * a, int b, NKSlider * s, bool * dirty)
1831{
1832 bool push_undo = false;
1833 if (*a != b)
1834 {
1835 if (!s->is_held)
1836 {
1837 s->byte_size = sizeof(int);
1838 memcpy(s->bytes, a, sizeof(int));
1839 push_undo = true;
1840 }
1841 s->is_held = true;
1842 if (dirty != NULL)
1843 {
1844 *dirty = true;
1845 }
1846 *a = b;
1847 destroy_redo_history();
1848 }
1849 else
1850 {
1851 s->is_held = false;
1852 }
1853
1854 return push_undo;
1855}

1929void load_filenames(FileDirectoryRegistry * registry)
1930{
1931 WIN32_FIND_DATAA find_data;
1932 char search_path[MAX_PATH];
1933 snprintf(search_path, sizeof(search_path), "%s\\*", registry->directory);
1934
1935 HANDLE hFind = FindFirstFileA(search_path, &find_data);
1936 if (hFind == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
1937
1938 registry->names.count = 0;
1939
1940 do {
1941 if (!(find_data.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)) {
1942
1943 if (registry->search_suffix)
1944 {
1945 // may have no null terminator
1946 if (strstr(find_data.cFileName, registry->suffix))
1947 {
1948 char * name = vector_expand(&registry->names, 1);
1949 strncpy(name, find_data.cFileName, 254);
1950 name[255] = '\0';
1951 }
1952 }
1953 else
1954 {
1955 char * name = vector_expand(&registry->names, 1);
1956 strncpy(name, find_data.cFileName, 254);
1957 name[255] = '\0';
1958 }
1959 }
1960 } while (FindNextFileA(hFind, &find_data));
1961
1962 FindClose(hFind);
1963
1964}

1966void load_rprobe_filenames(const char *folder_path) {

1968 WIN32_FIND_DATAA find_data;
1969 char search_path[MAX_PATH];
1970 snprintf(search_path, sizeof(search_path), "%s\\*", folder_path);
1971
1972 HANDLE hFind = FindFirstFileA(search_path, &find_data);
1973 if (hFind == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
1974
1975 rprobe_names_count = 0;
1976
1977 do {
1978 if (!(find_data.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)) {
1979 strncpy(rprobe_names[rprobe_names_count], find_data.cFileName, 255);
1980 rprobe_names_count++;
1981 }
1982 } while (FindNextFileA(hFind, &find_data));
1983
1984 FindClose(hFind);
1985}

2028void render_entity_menu()
2029{
2030
2031 if
2032 (
2033 nk_begin
2034 (
2035 NK_CTX,
2036 menu_names[MENU_ENT],
2037 nk_rect(420, SCREEN_HEIGHT - 320, SCREEN_WIDTH - 420 * 2, 300),
2038 NK_WINDOW_TITLE | NK_WINDOW_SCROLL_AUTO_HIDE | NK_WINDOW_CLOSABLE
2039 )
2040 )
2041 {

2043 if (nk_input_is_mouse_hovering_rect(&NK_CTX->input, win_bounds)) { NUKLEAR_HOVERED = true; }
2044 Entity * ent = &ENTITIES[EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_ent_id];
2045 nk_layout_row_dynamic(NK_CTX, 20, 1);
2046 PhysicsComponent * pc = NULL;
2047 AnimationComponent * ac = NULL;

2049
2050 nk_layout_row_dynamic(NK_CTX, 20, 1);
2051 char sk[256];
2052 sprintf(sk, "Skin: %d", ent->skin);
2053 nk_label(NK_CTX, sk, NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT);
2054
2055 if (nk_button_label(NK_CTX, "Player Interact"))
2056 {
2057
2058 if (ent->state)
2059 {
2060 ent->state->fn[ESTATE_PLAYER_INTERACT](ent);
2061 }
2062
2063 }
2064
2065
2066 if (ent->pc)
2067 {
2068 pc = ent->pc;
2069
2070 }
2071
2072 // possibly aabb controls
2073
2074 if (ent->ac)
2075 {
2076 ac = ent->ac;
2077 }
2078
2079 if (pc)
2080 {
2081 if (!pc->free)
2082 {
2083
2084 nk_layout_row_dynamic(NK_CTX, 20, 1);
2085 nk_label(NK_CTX, "PC Menu", NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT);
2086
2087 bool pc_dirty = false;
2088
2089 nk_layout_row_dynamic(NK_CTX, 20, 3);
2090 float mass = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, "Mass", 0.0f, pc->mass, 10000.0f, 0.01f, 0.01f);
2091 if (mass != pc->mass)
2092 {

2422mat3 mat3_rotation_x(float angle_radians) {
2423 float c = cosf(angle_radians);
2424 float s = sinf(angle_radians);
2425 return (mat3){
2426 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f,
2427 0.0f, c, -s,
2428 0.0f, s, c
2429 };
2430}
2431
2432
2433mat3 mat3_rotation_y(float angle_radians) {
2434 float c = cosf(angle_radians);
2435 float s = sinf(angle_radians);
2436 return (mat3){
2437 c, 0.0f, s,
2438 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f,
2439 -s, 0.0f, c
2440 };
2441}
2442
2443mat3 mat3_rotation_z(float angle_radians) {
2444 float c = cosf(angle_radians);
2445 float s = sinf(angle_radians);
2446 return (mat3){
2447 c, -s, 0.0f,
2448 s, c, 0.0f,
2449 0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f
2450 };
2451}

2453void obb_orthonormalize(OBB *obb) {
2454
2455
2456 vec3 fwd = {obb->rot.a0, obb->rot.a1, obb->rot.a2};
2457 vec3 right = {obb->rot.b0, obb->rot.b1, obb->rot.b2};
2458 vec3 up = {obb->rot.c0, obb->rot.c1, obb->rot.c2};
2459
2460 vec3 r = vec3_normalize(right);
2461
2462 vec3 u = up;
2463 u = vec3_sub(u, vec3_scale(r, vec3_dot(u, r)));
2464 u = vec3_normalize(u);
2465
2466 vec3 f = vec3_cross(r, u);
2467
2468 obb->rot.a0 = f.x;
2469 obb->rot.a1 = f.y;
2470 obb->rot.a2 = f.z;
2471 obb->rot.b0 = r.x;
2472 obb->rot.b1 = r.y;
2473 obb->rot.b2 = r.z;
2474 obb->rot.c0 = u.x;
2475 obb->rot.c1 = u.y;
2476 obb->rot.c2 = u.z;
2477
2478}

2728 UndoStructure uss = create_undo_structure(undo_type, (int[8]){id}, mat_special);
2729 UndoStructure rot_us = create_undo_structure(undo_type, (int[8]){id}, rot_special);

2752 {
2753 push_nk_slider_undo(&sliders[3], es, offsetof(EditorSettings, rotation_axis));
2754 }
2755
2756 if (rot_dirty)
2757 {
2758 EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_axis = vec3_normalize(EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_axis);
2759 }
2760
2761 float angle = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, final_names[6], 0, EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_angle, 2 * M_PI, 0.001f, 0.001f);
2762 bool angle_dirty = false;
2763 float rot_angle_old = EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_angle;
2764 if (check_equivalencyf(&EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_angle, angle, &sliders[4], &angle_dirty))
2765 {
2766 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*) * 3);
2767 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(float));
2768 bytes[1] = malloc(sizeof(mat4));
2769 bytes[2] = malloc(sizeof(vec3));
2770 memcpy(bytes[0], &rot_angle_old, sizeof(float));
2771 memcpy(bytes[1], mat, sizeof(mat4));
2772 memcpy(bytes[2], rot, sizeof(vec3));
2773
2774 size_t byte_size = sizeof(uint8_t*) * 2 + sizeof(float) + sizeof(mat4) + sizeof(vec3);
2775
2776 push_special_undo(rot_us, bytes, byte_size, 3, 0);
2777 }
2778 if (angle_dirty)
2779 {
2780
2781 EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_angle = angle;
2782 dirty = true;
2783 vec4 quat = quat_from_axis_angle(EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_axis, EDITOR_SETTINGS.rotation_angle);
2784 *rot = quat;
2785 }
2786
2787 vec3 s;
2788 s.x = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, final_names[7], -1000.0f, sc->x, 1000.0f, 0.01f, 0.01f);
2789
2790 s.y = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, final_names[8], -1000.0f, sc->y, 1000.0f, 0.01f, 0.01f);
2791
2792 s.z = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, final_names[9], -1000.0f, sc->z, 1000.0f, 0.01f, 0.01f);
2793 if (nk_check_equivalency(sc, &s, sizeof(vec3), &sliders[5], &dirty))
2794 {
2795 push_nk_slider_undo(&sliders[5], uss, scale_offset);
2796 }
2797
2798
2799
2800 if (dirty)
2801 {
2802 mat4 out_mat = compose_trs_from_vectors(*tr, *rot, *sc);
2803 *mat = out_mat;
2804
2805 }
2806
2807
2808}

2892 {
2893 push_nk_slider_undo(&sliders[5], us, offsetof(ProbeVolume, obb.extents.z));

2895 bool a_dirty = false;
2896 bool b_dirty = false;
2897 bool c_dirty = false;

2899 float obbrx = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, final_names[6], -M_PI, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_x_angle, M_PI, 0.01f, 0.01f);

2904
2905 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*) * 2);

2909 vec3 axis = {EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_x_angle, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_y_angle, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_z_angle};
2910 memcpy(bytes[1], &axis, sizeof(vec3));
2911 size_t byte_size = sizeof(uint8_t*) * 2 + sizeof(mat3) + sizeof(vec3);
2912
2913 push_special_undo(rot_us, bytes, byte_size, 2, offsetof(ProbeVolume, obb.rot));
2914
2915 }
2916
2917 float obbry = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, final_names[7], -M_PI, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_y_angle, M_PI, 0.01f, 0.01f);
2918 bool s7_is_held = sliders[7].is_held;
2919 check_equivalencyf(&EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_y_angle, obbry, &sliders[7], &b_dirty);
2920 if (!s7_is_held && sliders[7].is_held)
2921 {
2922
2923 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*) * 2);
2924 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(mat3));
2925 memcpy(bytes[0], &obb->rot, sizeof(mat3));
2926 bytes[1] = malloc(sizeof(vec3));
2927 vec3 axis = {EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_x_angle, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_y_angle, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_z_angle};
2928 memcpy(bytes[1], &axis, sizeof(vec3));
2929 size_t byte_size = sizeof(uint8_t*) * 2 + sizeof(mat3) + sizeof(vec3);
2930
2931 push_special_undo(rot_us, bytes, byte_size, 2, offsetof(ProbeVolume, obb.rot));
2932
2933 }
2934 float obbrz = nk_propertyf(NK_CTX, final_names[8], -M_PI, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_z_angle, M_PI, 0.01f, 0.01f);
2935
2936 bool s8_is_held = sliders[8].is_held;
2937 check_equivalencyf(&EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_z_angle, obbrz, &sliders[8], &c_dirty);
2938
2939 if (!s8_is_held && sliders[8].is_held)
2940 {
2941
2942 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*) * 2);
2943 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(mat3));
2944 memcpy(bytes[0], &obb->rot, sizeof(mat3));
2945 bytes[1] = malloc(sizeof(vec3));
2946 vec3 axis = {EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_x_angle, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_y_angle, EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_z_angle};
2947 memcpy(bytes[1], &axis, sizeof(vec3));
2948 size_t byte_size = sizeof(uint8_t*) * 2 + sizeof(mat3) + sizeof(vec3);
2949
2950 push_special_undo(rot_us, bytes, byte_size, 2, offsetof(ProbeVolume, obb.rot));
2951
2952 }
2953
2954 if (a_dirty || b_dirty || c_dirty)
2955 {
2956
2957
2958 obb->rot = mat3_identity();
2959 mat3 new_rot_x = mat3_rotation_x(EDITOR_SETTINGS.obb_axis_x_angle);

2964 obb->rot = mat3_mul(obb->rot, new_rot_z);
2965
2966 }
2967
2968
2969}

4841 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*) * LPV_SLOTS);
4842 size_t total_bytes = sizeof(uint8_t*) * LPV_SLOTS;
4843 for (int i = 0; i < LPV_SLOTS; i++)
4844 {
4845 if (GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[i].lprobes)
4846 {
4847
4848 size_t size = sizeof(float) * LPV_PADDED_COUNT * 3 * SH_MAX;
4849 bytes[i] = malloc(size);
4850 memcpy(bytes[i], GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[i].lprobes, size);
4851 total_bytes += size;
4852
4853 }
4854 else
4855 {
4856 bytes[i] = NULL;
4857 }
4858 }
4859 push_special_undo(
4860 create_undo_structure(UNDOSTRUCT_LPROBE,
4861 (int[8])
4862 {
4863 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[0].pv_id,
4864 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[1].pv_id,
4865 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[2].pv_id,
4866 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[3].pv_id,
4867 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[4].pv_id,
4868 GLOBALS.scene_data.LOADED_LIGHTING_PV[5].pv_id,
4869 }, UNDOLPROBE_RESET_LPVS), bytes, total_bytes, LPV_SLOTS, 0);
4870 reset_lighting_pvs();
4871 }
4872
4873
4874 if (EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id >= 0 && EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id < GLOBALS.scene_data.lighting_probe_volumes.count)
4875 {
4876
4877 ProbeVolume * pvs = CAST_VEC(GLOBALS.scene_data.lighting_probe_volumes, ProbeVolume);
4878 ProbeVolume * pv = &pvs[EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id];
4879
4880 nk_layout_row_dynamic(NK_CTX, 20, 1);
4881 char pv_data[256];
4882 sprintf(pv_data, "LPV Offset: %zu Size: %zu", pv->byte_offset, pv->size);
4883 nk_label(NK_CTX, pv_data, NK_TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT);
4884
4885 // render_obb_widget("LPV", &pv->obb);
4886 render_obb_widget("LPV", UNDOSTRUCT_LPROBE, EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id, &pv->obb, LPROBE_MENU.OBB_sliders);
4887
4888 if (nk_button_label(NK_CTX, "Reset LPV Rotation"))
4889 {
4890 push_raw_bytes_undo(&pv->obb.rot, sizeof(mat3), create_undo_structure(UNDOSTRUCT_LPROBE, (int[8]){EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id}, UNDOSPECIAL_NONE), offsetof(ProbeVolume, obb.rot));
4891 pv->obb.rot = mat3_identity();
4892 }
4893 if (nk_button_label(NK_CTX, "Reset LPV Size"))
4894 {
4895 push_special_undo(create_undo_structure(UNDOSTRUCT_LPROBE, (int[8]){EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id, pv->byte_offset, pv->size}, UNDOLPROBE_RESET_LPV_SIZE), NULL, 0, 0, 0);
4896 pv->byte_offset = 0;
4897 pv->size = 0;
4898 }
4899 if (nk_button_label(NK_CTX, "Delete LProbe Volume"))
4900 {
4901
4902 uint8_t ** bytes = malloc(sizeof(uint8_t*));
4903 bytes[0] = malloc(sizeof(ProbeVolume));
4904 memcpy(bytes[0], pv, sizeof(ProbeVolume));
4905 size_t byte_size = sizeof(uint8_t*) + sizeof(ProbeVolume);
4906 int byte_count = 1;
4907
4908 push_special_undo(create_undo_structure(UNDOSTRUCT_LPROBE, (int[8]){EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id}, UNDOLPROBE_DELETE), bytes, byte_size, byte_count, 0);
4909
4910 REMOVE_FROM_VEC(&GLOBALS.scene_data.lighting_probe_volumes, EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id, ProbeVolume);
4911 EDITOR_SETTINGS.selected_lighting_probe_volume_id = -1;
4912 }

4917 }
4918 if (nk_button_label(NK_CTX, "Bake LPV"))
4919 {
4920 bake_lighting_probe_volume(pv);
4921 }
4922
4923 }
4924
4925 }
4926 nk_end(NK_CTX);
4927 }
